name: Lynnette GreyBull
occupation: Advocate; founder, Not Our Native Daughters
background: Lynnette GreyBull of Fort Washakie ran as a Democrat for Wyoming’s U.S. House seat in 2022. In a 2022 statement, she said she had spent years directing, creating, and advocating in government and private organizations. She wrote that she founded Not Our Native Daughters; advocated federal prioritization of child-trafficking issues; worked on protecting free speech after Standing Rock; chaired the Arizona Commission for Indian Affairs; helped incarcerated women through the To Set the Captives Free Women’s Mission Program; testified for the Grizzly Bear Protection Act; and served as a liaison for the Wyoming Outdoor Council and the Citizens for the Red Desert Coalition. She described that people-centered work as the foundation of her approach to policy.
